name: Bronwen Grym
source:
"The Tigress". AKA [url=https://vndb.org/c146901]Cerys[/url]'s mother.

If [url=https://vndb.org/c146900]Áine[/url] is [url=https://vndb.org/c146899]Cymhen[/url]'s right hand, Bronwen is his left. A talented mage and ruthless businesswoman, she assists her father with work her sister is uncomfortable with.

She wasted little time in expressing her desire for Cer and [url=https://vndb.org/c146898]I[/url] to have children.
